related.title: Polaris：共享 PCIe 上游切面的超額需求
related.titleEn: Polaris: oversubscription at a shared PCIe upstream cut
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付雙平台數值驗證摘要、三條時間線、等待估計來源時間戳與含平手邊界的決策表；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障；附可執行實作：python3 tools/curriculum-v27/labs-hpc-a.py --lab hpc-v27-004 --out ./hpc-a-004-evidence；輸出資料夾須不存在，程式提供逐筆合成證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver correctness evidence for both alternatives, three timelines, wait-estimate timestamps and a decision table including the tie boundary. Explain which missing staging measurement would invalidate the simple comparison. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system. Executable fixture: python3 tools/curriculum-v27/labs-hpc-a.py --lab hpc-v27-004 --out ./hpc-a-004-evidence. The output directory must not exist; the program emits per-record synthetic evidence.
related.difference: 畫有向路徑圖，以 edge_id 展開每條流；在共同邊累加需求並保留端點與切面兩種報表。
related.differenceEn: Represent the topology as directed edges and expand each flow into edge identifiers. Aggregate demand on shared edges while preserving separate endpoint and cut reports, so an endpoint maximum cannot hide an upstream bottleneck.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 單階段估計完成時間為等待加運算；估計值必須有相同起點且包含資料已就緒的前提；CPU 路徑等待 60 秒、執行 540 秒；GPU 執行 120 秒，等待由 900 改為 300 秒；名義式 900+120 = 1020 s；變更式 300+120 = 420 s。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。

教學切面的超額需求為 max(0,兩流需求總和－切面容量)。只分析流量守恆與排隊傾向，不推定實際 GPU 直傳路徑；共享切面容量 16 GB/s；兩流各需求 12，變更為各 8 GB/s，其他路徑不設瓶頸；名義式 max(0,12+12-16) = 8 GB/s；變更式 max(0,8+8-16) = 0 GB/s。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For the deliberately single-stage fixture, completion estimate equals queue wait plus execution time. All estimates share a submission timestamp and assume required data are already staged and verified. The CPU alternative waits 60 seconds and runs for 540. The GPU alternative runs for 120 seconds; its estimated wait changes from 900 to 300. These values are invented, not NERSC queue predictions. Nominal 900+120 = 1020 s; changed 300+120 = 420 s. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

Model excess offered load as the positive difference between aggregate demand and cut capacity. This is a conservation constraint, not proof of the actual peer-transfer path, protocol efficiency or achieved throughput. Use a synthetic 16 GB/s cut shared by two flows. Each initially demands 12 GB/s, then 8 GB/s. Other links are assumed nonlimiting, and rates use decimal GB consistently. Nominal max(0,12+12-16) = 8 GB/s; changed max(0,8+8-16) = 0 GB/s. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Linux 記憶體熱移除：可移動頁與釘住區塊
related.titleEn: Linux memory hot-remove: movable pages and pinned blocks
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付雙平台數值驗證摘要、三條時間線、等待估計來源時間戳與含平手邊界的決策表；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障；附可執行實作：python3 tools/curriculum-v27/labs-hpc-a.py --lab hpc-v27-004 --out ./hpc-a-004-evidence；輸出資料夾須不存在，程式提供逐筆合成證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver correctness evidence for both alternatives, three timelines, wait-estimate timestamps and a decision table including the tie boundary. Explain which missing staging measurement would invalidate the simple comparison. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system. Executable fixture: python3 tools/curriculum-v27/labs-hpc-a.py --lab hpc-v27-004 --out ./hpc-a-004-evidence. The output directory must not exist; the program emits per-record synthetic evidence.
related.difference: 輸入 block_id、page_id、movable 與 pin_owner，產生 blocked_blocks 和可遷移頁清單；不得以釘住頁數直接減容量。
related.differenceEn: Input block_id, page_id, movable and pin_owner fields. Produce blocked-block and migratable-page lists, preserving the difference between the count of pinned pages and the capacity of blocks they obstruct.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 單階段估計完成時間為等待加運算；估計值必須有相同起點且包含資料已就緒的前提；CPU 路徑等待 60 秒、執行 540 秒；GPU 執行 120 秒，等待由 900 改為 300 秒；名義式 900+120 = 1020 s；變更式 300+120 = 420 s。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
本課保守模型將含釘住頁的區塊全部視為不可移除，其餘區塊視為可成功遷移；容量為可移除區塊數乘區塊大小；十個各 256 MiB 區塊；名義三個被釘住，變更五個被釘住，區塊大小與總容量固定；名義式 (10-3)*256 = 1792 MiB；變更式 (10-5)*256 = 1280 MiB。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For the deliberately single-stage fixture, completion estimate equals queue wait plus execution time. All estimates share a submission timestamp and assume required data are already staged and verified. The CPU alternative waits 60 seconds and runs for 540. The GPU alternative runs for 120 seconds; its estimated wait changes from 900 to 300. These values are invented, not NERSC queue predictions. Nominal 900+120 = 1020 s; changed 300+120 = 420 s. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

The conservative fixture marks every block containing a pinned page as nonremovable and assumes all remaining blocks can migrate successfully. Removable capacity is eligible block count times block size. Model ten blocks of 256 MiB. Three blocks initially contain pinned pages, then five do. Block size and total installed memory remain fixed; migration destination capacity is assumed sufficient. Nominal (10-3)*256 = 1792 MiB; changed (10-5)*256 = 1280 MiB. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
